name: iplib-hostmask
instr:
I'm restoring IPv6 hostmask support in our copy of go-iplib. We carve IPv6 allocations out of larger blocks and keep the rightmost bits of each address reserved, so the library has to step through addresses and count hosts while respecting that reserved region. In the root package, the hostmask functions in `hostmask.go` (`HostMask` methods and the increment, decrement, next and previous helpers) and the `Net6` methods in `net6.go` currently panic. Could you implement them?

The doc comments on those declarations, together with the ones on the `HostMask` and `Net6` types, are the contract; please follow them exactly, because our allocation tooling depends on the edge-case behaviour.

Please keep every exported name and signature as it is; private helpers are up to you. I'll run the package's own tests against it, and the rest of the module's tests (including the `iana` and `iid` packages) must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:embed` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build info; caller or stack lookups (`runtime.Caller`, `Callers`, `CallersFrames`, `FuncForPC`, `Stack`, `debug.Stack`, `debug.PrintStack`, `log.Lshortfile`, `log
